carried.from: the screening band (Moderate), not the observer's own impression

not_carried: partly reinforced banks: the app separates concrete from laid stones, and AquaPlot does not ask which
patchy bank vegetation: the app asks whether each bank is covered, and 'patchy' is neither
3 answer(s) only the vision model gave (algae, flow, water_clarity): confirm them in the review to carry them
photographs: the app takes uploaded file ids, so photos must be attached in the app itself
how the place made you feel (joy, serenity, anger, fear): AquaPlot does not ask
dams, pipes, discharges, water abstraction, construction and water height: AquaPlot does not ask
the macroinvertebrates: the app's citizen form has no place for them; they travel in the FHIR export instead
note: Built from the app's published answer codes. Only answers a person gave or confirmed are carried. Submitting needs an app account; AquaPlot prepares the body and does not send it.
